_doc: Optional pulldown groupings. A source listed here is split into named groups (each a metric subset); sources NOT listed default to one group = the whole source. Keys: id (stable), label_key (en.json), and ONE of: metrics[] (exactly these slugs, in order) | categories[] (only these) | exclude_categories[] (all but these); optional include_metrics[] adds slugs regardless of category. Pure config — regrouping needs no code change.
